_note: Builder environment presets. A preset sets gravity and may pre-fill the cabin atmosphere; the user can change every value, and every value used in a check is HYPOTHETICAL. Each number names the source it should be checked against. None of them has been verified by the team yet (verified_by is empty): open the source, confirm the number, add url + access_date, and put your name in verified_by, the same way as sources/sources.csv. Atmospheres with no source we trust are left null on purpose (rule 1).

presets.name: LEO / ISS
presets.gravity_source: Orbital free fall; PYRA treats it as 0 g, the same as 'microgravity' in evidence.GRAVITY_WORDS (DERIVED)
presets.atmosphere_source: ISS nominal cabin atmosphere (sea-level equivalent), NASA ISS ECLSS documentation: needs exact document, url and access date

presets.name: Lunar surface
presets.gravity_source: NASA NSSDC Moon Fact Sheet, surface gravity 1.62 m/s2 divided by 9.80665 m/s2: needs url and access date
presets.atmosphere_source: NASA Exploration Atmospheres Working Group recommendation (8.2 psia / 34% O2), believed to be NASA/TP-2010-216134: needs the report number, page, url and access date checked. The same values are the Prompt 16 input in the PYRA Master Prompt Pack.

presets.name: Mars transit
presets.gravity_source: Free fall in transit; PYRA treats it as 0 g (DERIVED)

presets.name: Mars surface
presets.gravity_source: NASA NSSDC Mars Fact Sheet, surface gravity 3.71 m/s2 divided by 9.80665 m/s2: needs url and access date
